description.value: Cycle Logic is a well-established multi-location BC bicycle shop — with branches in Kamloops, Prince George, Quesnel, Revelstoke, and Williams Lake — operating a full repair department out of its downtown Kamloops location. As a certified Shimano Service Center staffed by professionally trained mechanics, the shop handles everything from minor adjustments to complete overhauls, with bike fitting services also available. The retail floor covers a wide range of bicycles including e-bikes, a comprehensive parts selection, clothing, and accessories.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at cyclelogicbikes.com is live and confirms Cycle Logic as an active multi-location BC bicycle shop with a Kamloops location. The bike services subpage explicitly states walk-ins are welcome with no appointment required and describes professionally trained mechanics at a certified Shimano Service Center, directly supporting the staff mechanicals criterion. No website content addresses pump availability, rentals, washrooms, or most other optional amenities, so those remain null.
